import itertools
# universe of region types: subsets of {T,P,M,C}; a model = set of non-empty regions
regions=[frozenset(s) for r in range(1,5) for s in itertools.combinations('TPMC',r)]
I_all=True; II_all=True; nmod=0
for bits in itertools.product([0,1],repeat=len(regions)):
    m=[regions[i] for i,b in enumerate(bits) if b]
    if not any({'T','P'}<=r for r in m): continue
    if not any({'P','M'}<=r for r in m): continue
    if any({'M','C'}<=r for r in m): continue
    nmod+=1
    if not any({'C','P'}<=r for r in m): I_all=False
    if any({'T','C'}<=r for r in m): II_all=False
assert nmod>0
res=(I_all,II_all)
opts={'A':(True,False),'B':(True,True),'C':(False,False),'D':(False,True)}
assert res==opts['C']
for k in 'ABD': assert res!=opts[k]
